say:3:1222678001:1.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting.

choice_prompt:4:1222678001.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting.

say:5:1222678002:1.text: I'm choosing to trust Silvina—but that doesn't mean I'm handing Rustport's fate to her entirely.
say:5:1222678002:1.source_cn: 暂时相信西尔维娜吧——话虽如此，我也不可能把锈锚港的命...

say:8:1222678005:1.text: Look. This is the result of all our efforts these past few days.
say:8:1222678005:1.source_cn: 请看，这便是我们奔波数日的收获。

say:9:1222678006:1.text: I think I've found the best place for it.
say:9:1222678006:1.source_cn: 我想，我已经帮它找到了最好的归宿。

say:10:1222678007:0.text: When you continue your journey, I'd like you to take it with you.
say:10:1222678007:0.source_cn: 当你们再度踏上旅程时，请带上它吧。

say:12:1222678008:1.text: Sonja, are you really giving the relic to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!
say:12:1222678008:1.male: Sonja, are you really giving the relic to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!
say:12:1222678008:1.female: Sonja, are you really giving the relic to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!

say:14:1222678010:1.text: You've seen the atrocities Hodgkin committed with it. This relic would be too dangerous in the hands of a Graveborn. I even considered burying it, ensuring no one ever finds it.
say:14:1222678010:1.source_cn: 我不想将它交给亡灵。我也想过干脆把它埋藏起来，让它永远...

say:15:1222678011:1.text: But no matter what, it's a relic that the Empire wants, and many others will chase after it.
say:15:1222678011:1.source_cn: 但是，再怎么说，它是被亡灵们视为至宝的圣器，觊觎它的人...

say:16:1222678012:1.text: In the right hands, maybe it could serve a better purpose.
say:16:1222678012:1.source_cn: 如果它在可靠的人手中，说不定能发挥出更正当的用途。

say:17:1222678013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
say:17:1222678013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
say:17:1222678013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.

choice_prompt:18:1222678013.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
choice_prompt:18:1222678013.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
choice_prompt:18:1222678013.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.

say:19:1222678014:1.text: Hey, no worries! Chippy is super strong, Chippy will carry anything that doesn't fit in your pack!
say:19:1222678014:1.source_cn: 背包什么的，全都丢给满满！绝对不能让主人累着！
say:19:1222678014:1.male: Hey, no worries! Chippy is super strong, Chippy will carry anything that doesn't fit in your pack!
say:19:1222678014:1.female: Hey, no worries! Chippy is super strong, Chippy will carry anything that doesn't fit in your pack!

say:20:1222678018:1.text: When you're ready to set out, just say the word. Rustport will make sure you get a proper send-off.
say:20:1222678018:1.source_cn: 等你打算启程时，请务必告诉我——锈锚港会为你举行盛大的送行！
say:20:1222678018:1.male: When you're ready to set out, just say the word. Rustport will make sure you get a proper send-off.
say:20:1222678018:1.female: When you're ready to set out, just say the word. Rustport will make sure you get a proper send-off.

choice:18:0:1.text: This is a lot to carry.
choice:18:0:1.male: This is a lot to carry.
choice:18:0:1.female: This is a lot to carry.

say:22:1222678015:1.text: Be careful, it's packed with unimaginable power.
say:22:1222678015:1.source_cn: 要小心呀……这里面蕴含着深不可测的魔法。

say:23:1222678016:1.text: With your skills, I sincerely doubt anyone could take it from you.
say:23:1222678016:1.source_cn: 以你的能力，我相信没人能从你手中抢走它。
say:23:1222678016:1.male: With your skills, I sincerely doubt anyone could take it from you.
say:23:1222678016:1.female: With your skills, I sincerely doubt anyone could take it from you.

say:24:1222678017:1.text: And really, thank you again, for everything.
say:24:1222678017:1.source_cn: 多谢你，再次帮了我们一个大忙。
say:24:1222678017:1.male: And really, thank you again, for everything.
say:24:1222678017:1.female: And really, thank you again, for everything.

choice:18:2:3.text: This is a real hot potato...
choice:18:2:3.male: This is a real hot potato...
choice:18:2:3.female: This is a real hot potato...

say:25:1222678003:1.text: It wasn't an easy decision, especially with an entire empire backing her.
say:25:1222678003:1.source_cn: 这个决定不太容易，考虑到她背后有一整个帝国，实在是棘手。
